To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the data analysis is an important and useful activity in the development of a theory of a given domain.

(i) the term data analysis is used to cover all the activities mentioned above and, in addition, to cover a variety of techniques for data analysis that are not covered in the traditional statistics, (ii) the term knowledge is used to cover a variety not only of facts, but also concepts and relations, (iii) the term knowledge structure is used to cover both concepts and relations, and (iv) the term knowledge enhancement is used for the process of augmenting the existing knowledge structure.
In summary, our research is concerned with

data analysis as a process of augmenting and enhancing theoretical knowledge of the domain the data refer to, which is represented by the structure of concepts and statements of correlation between them.
data analysis as a means for augmenting theoretical knowledge of the domain a dataset relates to.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the main goal of data analysis is to augment knowledge about a phenomenon by (i) developing and refining concepts and (ii ) enhancing and establishing relations between concepts.
the term "Data Analysis" covers a wide range of methods and techniques for processing and analyzing datasets in order to enhance knowledge of the domain the data relate to.

data analysis is the study of methods and techniques for analyzing data, with the aim of enhancing the knowledge of the phenomenon the data refer to, in particular by developing concepts and relations between concepts.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
data analysis is the activity of finding, developing, and enhancing knowledge of the domain of the dataset under consideration.
data analysis is a process of developing and augmenting knowledge structures in terms of concepts and relations between them, which can be used for understanding and prediction.
data analysis can be viewed as a set of techniques and methods for enhancing theoretical knowledge about the domain a dataset is taken from.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the term Data Analysis should be used to denote a set of activities aimed at augmenting and enhancing theoretical knowledge of the domain of data in question.
there is a lot of substance to data analysis.
the term data analysis is used in a wide range of contexts, from data mining to statistics to machine learning.
